title: DOOM (2016)
summary: Experimental RenoDX HDR10 tone mapping and color grading for Vulkan builds of DOOM (2016).
notes: Tested on the inspected GOG Vulkan x64 build and a user-confirmed Steam Vulkan build; other builds remain shader-contract gated.
Requires ReShade 6.8.0 Full Add-On and DOOMx64vk.exe.
Auto HDR and NVIDIA RTX HDR must be disabled.
HDR10 format and color space are selected when the Vulkan swapchain is created; changing Output Mode requires a game restart until a safe DOOM swapchain-recreation trigger is proven.
Preset Off saves neutral SDR and Vanilla settings, but a restart is required to restore the original Vulkan swapchain and output path.
VK_EXT_hdr_metadata is not enabled by the inspected executable/ReShade device path, so explicit static HDR metadata is not yet published by this experimental build.
PsychoV-25 full-resolution performance and subtitles, automap, all loading transitions and every video path remain provisional acceptance areas.
Disable third-party implicit Vulkan layers such as RTSS, OBS Vulkan capture and Steam overlay/Fossilize when using the HDR proxy; DOOM's built-in performance statistics overlay is not RTSS.
